tests/docs: scrub branches.json nonexistence checks

Removes negative assertions ('no branches.json exists') from the
happy, integration, and template tests — the principle lives in
PRINCIPLES.md. Also scrubs residual references the bl-4652
unwind missed: stale ARCH §3.1 / §7 UI doc mentions, the
fs_watcher allowlist (branches.json was a watched prefix;
replaced with a pointer to .git/refs/), and the redundant
detects_branches_json_update test. No behavior changes.
